title: Old Debts
triggerDescription: Triggers when a survivor enters the Police Station.
narrative: You find a wanted poster with a familiar face. It's your fellow survivor. Do you turn them in?

choices.outcome: The survivor is exiled. +1 morale.
They owe you a favour. Nothing changes for now.

title: Found Supplies
triggerDescription: Triggers when a survivor searches any location.
narrative: You find a stash of supplies, but someone is already there protecting it.

choices.outcome: Gain 2 food. Take 1 wound.
Gain 1 food. The stranger joins the colony.
Nothing gained or lost.

title: A Stranger at the Gate
triggerDescription: Triggers at the end of any player's turn.
narrative: A desperate stranger knocks at the colony gate, begging for shelter.

choices.outcome: They join the colony but eat one food.
Morale drops. One survivor is deeply troubled.

title: Frostbitten
triggerDescription: Triggers when a survivor moves in round 4 or later.
narrative: The cold has gotten to you. Your fingers are numb and you can barely grip your weapon.

choices.outcome: Take 1 wound. Complete the action.
Spend a medicine card. No further action this turn.

title: Midnight Scavenge
triggerDescription: Triggers when searching at night (round 3+).
narrative: You slip out in the dark and find something valuable, but noise might attract zombies.

choices.outcome: Find a random item. Spawn 1 zombie at your location.
Take 1 normal search result only.

title: Hidden Cache
triggerDescription: Triggers when searching the Library.
narrative: Behind a false wall, you find a hidden cache of supplies.

choices.outcome: Gain 2 random items, but your pack is now full.
+1 morale and gain 1 item.

title: Guilt
triggerDescription: Triggers after a survivor kills their first zombie.
narrative: The zombie bore a name tag. You recognize the name as someone from your past.

choices.outcome: Lose 1 action die this round. +1 morale.
Continue without penalty.

title: The Informer
triggerDescription: Triggers at end of round when 3+ players are in the colony.
narrative: Word spreads that someone has been leaking colony movements to the bandits.

choices.outcome: Spend 2 influence. Reveal one player's role.
The leak continues. -1 morale next round.

title: Abandoned Child
triggerDescription: Triggers when moving through the School.
narrative: A small child hides under a desk, alone and terrified.

choices.outcome: +2 morale but the noise attracts 2 zombies.
-2 morale.

title: Territorial Survivors
triggerDescription: Triggers when entering the Grocery Store with 2+ zombies.
narrative: A group of survivors has claimed the store for themselves and doesn't want company.

choices.outcome: Take 1 wound. Gain 2 food.
Lose 1 influence. Gain 1 food peacefully.
Nothing gained.

title: Signal Fire
triggerDescription: Triggers when using a fuel item.
narrative: You could use this fuel to signal for help, but it would draw every zombie in the area.

choices.outcome: +2 morale, spawn 4 zombies at colony.
Nothing changes.

title: Wounded Ally
triggerDescription: Triggers after a combat in which a survivor takes a wound.
narrative: Your ally is badly hurt and begging you not to leave them behind.

choices.outcome: Move them to colony. You spend all remaining action dice.
Use 1 medicine. They can act normally next round.
They take 1 more wound. -2 morale.

title: Black Market
triggerDescription: Triggers when entering the Gas Station.
narrative: A shady trader offers you contraband goods at a steep price.

choices.outcome: Spend 2 food. Gain 1 weapon and 1 medicine.
+1 morale. They disappear.
Nothing changes.

title: Sacrifice
triggerDescription: Triggers if any survivor has 3 or more wounds.
narrative: A survivor with grievous wounds offers to act as a distraction to save the others.

choices.outcome: They are eliminated. Remove 2 zombies from their location. +1 morale.
They survive at 1 wound. All survivors at location take 1 wound.

title: Haunted Memories
triggerDescription: Triggers when searching the Hospital.
narrative: You find a photo album amid the wreckage. The faces stare back at you.

choices.outcome: Nothing changes, but you feel connected to something.
+1 morale.
The pain fades. -1 wound.

title: Food Fight
triggerDescription: Triggers when a food item is played at the colony.
narrative: Two survivors argue over the last can of beans. It nearly comes to blows.

choices.outcome: Spend 1 influence. The argument ends peacefully.
One takes 1 wound. The other gains +1 influence.

title: Zombie Horde Incoming
triggerDescription: Triggers at the end of round 5.
narrative: Scouts report a massive horde is moving toward the colony.

choices.outcome: Spend 2 tools. +2 barricades at colony.
+1 fuel to colony stockpile.
+3 zombies at colony next round.

title: Lost in the Dark
triggerDescription: Triggers when moving at night (round 5+).
narrative: Visibility is near zero. You take a wrong turn and end up somewhere unexpected.

choices.outcome: Move to a random location instead of intended.
Lose this movement action. Stay in place.

title: An Unlikely Friend
triggerDescription: Triggers after clearing a location of zombies.
narrative: As the last zombie falls, you notice a tame dog emerge from under a car.

choices.outcome: +2 morale but uses 1 food per round.
Nothing changes.

title: Power Struggle
triggerDescription: Triggers when two players each have 4+ influence.
narrative: Two strong personalities clash over how the colony should be run.

choices.outcome: Player A gains 1 morale. Player B loses 1 influence.
Player B gains 1 morale. Player A loses 1 influence.
Both lose 1 influence, +1 morale.

title: Supply Drop
triggerDescription: Triggers on a search result of 6.
narrative: A military supply drop lands nearby with a loud crash.

choices.outcome: Gain 3 random items but spawn 2 zombies.

choices.text: Wait for the noise to die down
choices.outcome: Gain 2 random items safely.

title: Hidden Betrayer
triggerDescription: Triggers at the end of round 6 if no betrayer has been exiled.
narrative: Suspicion grows. Someone has been working against the group.

choices.outcome: Hold an immediate exile vote.
-1 morale now. If betrayer acts next round, they are revealed.

title: Radio Transmission
triggerDescription: Triggers when using a Radio item.
narrative: Through the static, you pick up a distress signal from another survivor group.

choices.outcome: They arrive next round. +1 survivor, +1 morale, +1 zombie spawn.
Nothing changes.

title: Zombie Swarm
triggerDescription: Triggers when 5+ zombies are at a single location.
narrative: The horde is bigger than you thought. Everywhere you turn, there are dead eyes staring.

choices.outcome: Take 1 wound. Kill 1 zombie.
Move away without killing. No wounds.

title: The Last Doctor
triggerDescription: Triggers when a character with medical ability enters the Hospital.
narrative: A doctor from before the outbreak is treating survivors in a make-shift ward.

choices.outcome: +2 morale. Medicine items count double next round.
Nothing changes.
